title: NASA Sun fact sheet: mean density 1408.
summary: The Sun fact sheet lists mean density as 1408.
body: NASA's Sun fact sheet lists Mean density (kg/m 3 ) as 1408. for the Sun. A bulk-parameter cell. The sheet does not label this cell as a model. Mass, volumetric mean radius, luminosity, spectral type, and the sidereal rotation period are on other cards and are not repeated as the claim here. Last Updated line: 9 May 2024.
